summary: [standards] Two bound tests prove less than the scenario they are bound to. atip_codestable_02 (the only test the evidence of atip.codestable.02 names) spot-checks five rows and that each why is non-empty; the per-row comparison of before/after exit, retryable, reasons and kind that the scenario states is in table_problems, which only atip_codestable_01 calls. atip_codenames_04's only bound test covers the first half of the new Then (a name without a condition or with a wrong exit is refused); 'every code of the registry follows the rule with nothing exempt' lives in atip_codenames_03 and atip_codestable_05. The claims hold (I checked every row against schema --errors of this build and ran the tests), but a mutation of one row's exit-after fails 01 and leaves 02 green. Have 02 assert table_problems is empty, and have the codenames.04 test (or its scenario) cover or name the all-codes check.
